title: Record breaking reasoning, identity-control, cyber-access, image-migration, and incident contracts without provider adoption
problem: Anthropic released Fable/Mythos 5.2 and consequence-bearing organization controls; OpenAI released a privileged cyber model, changed image contracts, and reported broad outage plus incorrect cost exports. Decide whether to amend protocol law, adopt or migrate, record evidence only, or make no repository change.
baseline: Default routes are local-first. DALEOBANKS alone retains optional legacy OpenAI Chat Completions and embeddings. No Fable/Mythos 5.2, Anthropic organization control, GPT-6-Cyber, GPT Image, Kimi, or provider Costs API integration was found. Draft PR 105 section 7 already governs exact contracts, leased state, receipts, retries, cost, independent evaluation, credentials/data scope, and duplicate runtimes.

alternatives.name: Evidence-only update
alternatives.description: Add the dated packet and this deliberation; change no protocol text or runtime.
advantages: Preserves breaking contracts and direct incident evidence
alternatives.revival_evidence: Selected because breaking reasoning/retention and identity-control contracts plus direct OpenAI outage/cost evidence cross the materiality gate.

alternatives.name: Vendor-specific protocol amendment
alternatives.description: Add named Anthropic and OpenAI clauses.
disadvantages: Couples constitutional text to volatile products
alternatives.revival_evidence: A deterministic failure demonstrates an invariant missing from section 7.

alternatives.name: Immediate adoption or migration
alternatives.description: Adopt Fable 5.2, Anthropic controls, GPT-6-Cyber, or Image 2.6 now.
advantages: Could add capability, security, speed, or visual tooling
disadvantages: No route, account contract, retention approval, benchmark, target authorization, or founder approval exists
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder-approved sandbox with pinned contracts, least privilege, independent acceptance, total-cost ceiling, and rollback.

alternatives.name: Provider-native authority and runtime
alternatives.description: Let provider history, admin controls, tools, security programs, retries, and evaluators own collaboration state.
disadvantages: Violates canonical authority, one-source-of-truth, evaluator independence, and no-duplicate-runtime constraints
alternatives.revival_evidence: None while UNIIMENTE requires one canonical authority, task, receipt, evidence, cost, and consequence plane.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Brief the user and leave PR 105 unchanged.
disadvantages: Loses durable Fable 5.2, identity-control, cyber-access, image-deprecation, and incident evidence

roles.position: Keep provider reasoning, identity controls, access programs, and tools subordinate to human authority and one canonical machine.
material_concerns: Provider security eligibility must not become target authorization
Provider revocation or history state must not redefine canonical truth

roles.position: Bind every provider artifact and control operation to exact model, account/project, prefix, tools, platform, canonical attempt, and receipt.
material_concerns: Silent reasoning drops break replay equivalence
Admin controls and hosted tools can create second state and retry planes

roles.position: Make no repository change because direct feature exposure is negative and section 7 already covers the invariants.
material_concerns: Five role prompts are one model's self-review
Official pages can change after capture
evidence_refs: Negative searches on four default branches

roles.position: Record contracts and failure semantics; build no adapter until authorized exposure exists.
material_concerns: Allowlist lockout and incomplete sign-out complicate recovery
Long context, fast modes, tools, image partials, and retries hide cost

roles.position: Treat thinking, audit, status, cost exports, and model verification as bounded evidence requiring independent reconciliation.
material_concerns: Incorrect provider cost exports can corrupt budgets

evidence.claim: Anthropic released Fable/Mythos 5.2 with breaking prefix, cross-model thinking, computer-tool, advisor, retention, and price contracts.
evidence.finding: Release dated 2026-11-09; no direct repository exposure found.

evidence.claim: Anthropic added organization IP allowlisting and member sign-out controls.
evidence.finding: Release dated 2026-11-05; controls have propagation, coverage, credential, and incomplete-revocation boundaries.

evidence.claim: OpenAI released GPT-6-Cyber and deprecated GPT-5.5-Cyber Preview.
evidence.finding: Release/deprecation dated 2026-11-05; privileged project, allowlist, retention, target-authorization, and high-cost contracts apply.

evidence.claim: OpenAI released Image 2.6 and deprecated GPT Image 2.
evidence.finding: Launch dated 2026-11-04; deprecation dated 2026-11-10 with shutdown 2027-02-10; no direct exposure found.

evidence.claim: OpenAI broad outages and incorrect cost exports occurred during the review window.
evidence.finding: All-model/API outage on November 8; API errors November 9; incorrect exports covering November 6-9 resolved November 10. DALEOBANKS optional routes are directly incident-exposed.

evidence.claim: Current default branches lack direct exposure to new provider features.
evidence.reference: GitHub exact searches at Kernel d64a6c93, DALEOBANKS 667439f4, WMI ec82b802, PumpStation db6758df on 2026-11-10
evidence.finding: DALEOBANKS retains optional gpt-4o-mini Chat Completions and text-embedding-3-small only; no new model/control/cost consumer found.

counterevidence.claim: New constitutional protocol text is necessary.
counterevidence.finding: Existing provider-neutral rules cover every observed invariant.

counterevidence.reference: No provider account, credential, contract, or live call was accessed
counterevidence.finding: Integration behavior remains prospective except repository-visible optional OpenAI route exposure to broad incidents.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Preserve one canonical, retry-safe, independently evaluated, privacy- and cost-bounded collaboration runtime while recording actionable provider contracts and incidents.

advantages.statement: Dated evidence captures breaking reasoning, retention, identity-control, access-program, image-migration, and cost-reconciliation contracts.
advantages.amplified_value: Future owners can test or reject features from official contracts without adopting them now.

advantages.statement: Provider-neutral rules absorb new products without constitutional churn.
advantages.amplified_value: Canonical authority remains stable across changing vendors, models, tools, and control planes.

disadvantages.statement: Another weekly record increases review debt.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Add two unique evidence files and one bounded PR-body delta only.

disadvantages.statement: New provider features have no direct default-branch exposure.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Label feature exposure negative and defer code until authorized use exists.

disadvantages.statement: Reasoning drops, model switches, and ambiguous API failures can cause unsafe replay.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Require exact artifact binding, canonical receipts, and reconciliation before retry or failover.

disadvantages.statement: Admin controls and privileged cyber programs widen identity, credential, retention, and target scope.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Perform no account action; require least privilege, target authorization, complete coverage mapping, and rollback fixtures.

disadvantages.statement: Provider cost exports were incorrect and may corrupt budget decisions.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Preserve raw receipts and exports; append corrections with lineage and independent reconciliation.

disadvantages.statement: One model's structured five-role review is not independent approval.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep draft status and require founder or delegated independent review.

comparisons.baseline: Local-first defaults, optional legacy OpenAI calls, no Anthropic/Kimi route, generic provider controls.
comparisons.do_nothing: Avoids review debt but loses durable breaking-contract, direct outage, and cost-integrity evidence.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: User brief only; lower burden but weak for the existing official-source evidence lineage and direct incident exposure.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Provider histories, admin controls, security programs, tools, retries, and evaluators own state; convenient but incompatible with canonical authority and evaluator independence.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: If authorized, replay frozen reasoning/admin/cyber/image/outage fixtures offline, then run a cost-capped sandbox with no external effect and independent acceptance.

rejected_alternatives.name: Add vendor-specific law
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: A deterministic failure proves an uncovered invariant.

rejected_alternatives.name: Adopt or migrate now
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: No authorized route, target, account contract, retention proof, benchmark, or founder approval exists.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Authorized need plus pinned fixtures, least privilege, independent evaluation, total-cost review, and rollback.

rejected_alternatives.name: Inspect accounts or credentials
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: This review lacks authority to access provider accounts, secrets, policies, projects, or billing.

pass_2.attack_summary: The evidence-only design can become bureaucracy, overstate one-model review, rely on mutable provider pages, miss non-repository use, or normalize provider identity and security controls as authority.

new_weaknesses.statement: The recurring draft can become harder to review than the risk.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Keep this cycle to two evidence files and one body section; no protocol or code change.

new_weaknesses.statement: Provider reasoning, identity, security, and cost evidence can create vendor dependence.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Retain canonical artifacts and independent reconciliation; forbid provider-owned authority or evaluation.

new_weaknesses.statement: Provider docs, status, and prices can change after capture.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Preserve dates, URLs, exact branch SHAs, and require a fresh check before implementation.

new_weaknesses.statement: Long context, always-on thinking, fast modes, hosted tools, image partials, and retries can hide total cost.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Reconcile every operation and kill adoption when complete cost is unavailable.

new_weaknesses.statement: IP allowlisting or sign-out can be mistaken for complete containment.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Require explicit uncovered-path and unaffected-credential/session records plus independent postcondition checks.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Breaking contracts and direct outage/cost evidence justify one evidence-only update.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Next cycle; brief-only unless materiality is met

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No adapter or migration is built until authorized exposure exists.
Existing exact-binding and receipt-gated recovery rules cover replay and retry.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any model switch, dropped block, timeout, 5xx, or unknown state

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: No account, credential, allowlist, member, access program, project, target, or retention setting is touched.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any identity, admin, cyber, or account task

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Original receipts remain immutable and corrections become append-only reconciliation events.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Any corrected provider export, credit, refund, or invoice

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Five roles are labelled self-review and cannot authorize adoption or merge.

pass_2.final_design: Add only the 2026-11-10 official-source evidence packet and validated deliberation to draft PR 105; leave section 7 and all runtime, routes, accounts, credentials, production, authority, and default branches unchanged.

residual_risks.mitigation: Require a separate authorized inventory before any migration or deadline.

residual_risks.risk: The deliberation is not independent approval.
residual_risks.mitigation: Keep draft status and require founder or delegated human decision.

residual_risks.risk: Provider contracts can change after capture.
residual_risks.mitigation: Recheck official sources and pin fixtures before any canary.

dissent.handling: Preserve the brief-only objection. It controls scope: no protocol text, runtime code, fixture, provider call, account inspection, or migration. Breaking Fable 5.2/control/cyber contracts and direct OpenAI incident/cost evidence justify only dated evidence.

entries.position: Make no repository change because direct feature exposure is negative and existing rules are sufficient.
entries.rationale: Recurring model-authored records can create bureaucracy and de facto policy authority.
entries.evidence_threshold: Future updates require direct exposure, a hard effective transition, breaking contract, material incident, or uncovered invariant.
entries.review_trigger: Founder review or next weekly cycle

migration_plan: No runtime migration. If exposure is authorized, pin provider/model/API/platform/region/tool/access-program/retention/speed contracts; translate every operation and retry into canonical attempts and receipts; prove replay, revocation, outage, and cost recovery with deterministic fixtures; perform independent evaluation and credential/retention/residency/target/cost review; then run a founder-approved sandbox.

steps: Leave draft PR 105 unmerged or revert only the 2026-11-10 evidence commits
Preserve evidence and dissent as historical records
Return to brief-only reporting for immaterial cycles

kill_criteria: Any default-branch write or unapproved merge
Any account, credential, production, routing, spending, target, or authority change
Any provider-owned canonical history, identity, authorization, task, evidence, evaluator, receipt, retry, cost, scheduler, or runtime
Any retry or failover without receipt and idempotency reconciliation
Any silently dropped reasoning treated as equivalent replay
Any incomplete revocation represented as complete
Any unapproved security target, 30-day retention, region, or data scope
Any missing thinking, tool, image, retry, or corrected-export cost
review_trigger: Founder review of PR 105; any Fable/Mythos 5.2, Anthropic admin/allowlist, GPT-6-Cyber, GPT Image migration, or incident with ambiguous completion or corrected cost
